items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Ernie Fields refers to 'Christopher' as a song/record title ('Christopher number one', 'Christopher is a good number'), not a person.

ctx.x: Columbus, it says another revival of an oldie for teen tastes, and results in making the grade too. (Inaudible) songsters are included here, two tracks--you had some girls?

We had a background and Rene laughed, he said you've just got to have somebody singing or something so we put a little humming in there. I'll tell you about how it went. We got a good review in Billboard also and so they made Christopher number one--I mean A. So they were playing it and a DJ was in Oklahoma City, he used to be in Tulsa, and he knew me personally and he played it, he played around with Christopher for a week or two, and then he played In The Mood, but he never would play it on the air, like the…
